name: creations_finalize_upload
description: Step 2 after PUT from `creations_request_upload`: convert temp path(s) to creations. Pass the source `fileName` so the creation is born with the user's file name; if you generated the content yourself, provide a short descriptive name. SVG <=10MB, raster images <=25MB, audio <=50MB, videos <=200MB.

fileName.description: Name of the source file, including extension. If you generated the content yourself, provide a short descriptive name instead.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

fileName.description: Name of the source file, including extension. If you generated the content yourself, provide a short descriptive name instead.

visible.description: Show the upload in the user's library. Default true; pass false for a throwaway working asset.
